what: The touch wheel's Minute column under a held finger: its inline (from the gesture host's selection lock) and computed -webkit-user-select and -webkit-touch-callout, at each touch and pointer event and every sixth frame
where: Mobile Safari, iOS 26.2 simulator (iPhone 17 Pro), TimeInput story bottom-sheet-with-min-max, one-touch-model stack top
ua: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_7 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/26.2 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
summary: From the finger landing (touchstart) to its lift (touchend, 2.66 s later) the column computes -webkit-user-select: none and -webkit-touch-callout: none, set inline by the gesture host; no contextmenu or selectstart fired; both are back to text/default on the next frame after the lift.
